tools.name: record_overview
tools.description: Start here. What this record holds, what it refuses to do, and the latest changes. Read it before assuming what is available.

tools.name: find_fabs
tools.description: Search the fab sites in the record by country, operator, kind, status, wafer size or process node. Every row names the publisher it came from; rows with no publisher are not returned.

tools.name: fab_profile
tools.description: One fab site in full, including the note that says what this record does not know about it, and every capacity statement whose sentence covers it.

tools.name: list_figures
tools.description: Every published forecast subject in the record and each year it has been forecast for, with how many vintages exist. Use it to find a subject_id for figure_history.

tools.name: figure_history
tools.description: The revision history of one published figure: every vintage, what the publisher said in their own words, the date they issued it, and the link. Includes the restatements as pairs of published values. Call this when a number is quoted and you want to know what the same publisher said before. It state

tools.name: recent_changes
tools.description: Figures that publishers restated recently, each an old value and a new value with both links. Says what changed and never what it means.

tools.name: record_gaps
tools.description: What this record is missing and why each one is open. Call it before concluding a figure exists. Statuses distinguish "nobody publishes this" from "the source costs money" from "we have the URLs and have not done the work".

tools.name: list_sources
tools.description: Every publisher this record collects, across BOTH mechanisms: their feed, or their own sitemap. A publisher absent from one may be present in the other.

tools.name: node_bands
tools.description: How named publishers have defined process-node bands such as "advanced", each as a dated statement with its wafer basis. This record defines no bands of its own.
